observationExport.cursor: completed collection-day range; original measured interval retained

dailyOutbox.receipt: Same id and status pending|delivering|completed|failed; acceptance is scheduler durability, not domain success.
dailyOutbox.availability: relay queues pending rows without an availability filter; scheduler owns timed execution.
dailyOutbox.failure: Malformed or lost receipt retains the oldest pending row; concurrent retries require recipient deduplication.
dailyOutbox.hostedGap: No hosted outbox/relay route or authenticated HTTPS sender; local_sender is loopback HTTP.

contacts.cursor: available_at|sequence, available-only relative to world clock
contacts.hostedGap: No hosted intent feed or relay route

payments.cursor: integer sequence, available-only relative to world clock
payments.semantics: Intention reserves household cash; transport acceptance does not settle cash or enterprise ledger.
payments.hostedGap: No hosted payment-intent feed or relay route

invoiceReturn.semantics: Trusted actually delivered invoice/notice, matched world/run/cohort; USD positive cents; due/delivery dates retained; durable exact inbox dedup.

providerReturn.semantics: Full intent amount/fingerprint only. Settled consumes reserved cash; returned requires linked settlement and refunds; v2 failed releases reservation. No partial settlement.

financialContacts.semantics: Requires actual received notice and known invoice; separate policy is not enabled by hosted v4 setup.

field.semantics: Separate field DB/outbox, stable assignment/revision/report identities; physical visit and reported claim are distinct.
field.hostedGap: No hosted assignment/execute/report adapter. Legacy field-world-report/1 schema is not the current execution envelope.

clockAndLimits: Managed delivery configuration prevents competing manual world advance.
DailyWorld commits a day and relays its durable outbox before completion; pending prior delivery blocks the next daily job.
VS Run.enqueue accepts durably, Run.advance orders available/sequence and rejects new backdated commands; no continuous hosted supervisor confirmed.
Producer envelope limit8MiB; gateway request64KiB, response3000000bytes, timeout20seconds. Hosted batching/transport needs explicit design without changing source identity.
Call-centre experienced-outcome return for sentiment remains a new contract gap.
